label: MARKETING TERM
headline: What is Retargeting?
body: Retargeting shows ads to people who have already visited your website or interacted with your content, reminding them about your offerings.
caption:
Ever noticed how an ad for a product you just looked at online follows you around? That's retargeting! It helps you stay top of mind with potential customers who've already shown interest. For example, if someone views your online course page but doesn't sign up right away, retargeting can show them an ad for that course later on.
